data.key: Deep One Corruption ~ Slow Aging Stain
data.name: Slow Aging Stain
data.description: You dream of lost cities in ages primordial and are haunted by strange aeons long since forgotten. You require 16 hours of sleep for a night's rest and you are incapable of deriving benefit from effects that replace the need for sleep (like a ring of sustenance) or ameliorate, suppress, or remove the effects of lack of sleep.
